Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot is capable of solving nearly any puzzle or conundrum, including how to fit a square peg into a round hole.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Why dodge when you can take the hit and still be standing? This pilot prefers crushing enemies underfoot while lining up the final shot. +21 affinity with all assault 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 能挨住一击还站着，何必躲闪？这名飞行员更喜欢在瞄准最后一击时把敌人踩在脚下。与所有突击机甲的契合度+21（在战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No need to run when the enemy's weapons barely make a dent. This pilot prefers to let the enemy panic while lining up the last shot they'll ever see. +42 affinity with all assault 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当敌人的武器几乎打不穿你时，就没必要跑了。这名飞行员更喜欢让敌人恐慌，同时瞄准他们此生见到的最后一击。与所有突击机甲的契合度+42（在战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor for days, firepower to match. This pilot prefers staying in the fight long enough to line up the perfect shot. +21 affinity with all heavy 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 装甲管够，火力相配。这名飞行员更喜欢留在战斗中足够久，以瞄准完美的一击。与所有重型机甲的契合度+21（在战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tanky With a Side of Sniper
This pilot knows that a little extra armor means a lot more time to land the perfect shot—preferably straight through the cockpit. +42 affinity with all heavy 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员深知，多一点装甲就意味着多得多的时间去打出完美一枪——最好是直接穿过座舱。与所有重型机甲的契合度+42（在战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built Like a Brick, Shoots Like a Sniper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 砖墙般坚固，狙击手般精准

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot runs a food delivery business and needs to move fast to keep business booming. +20 affinity with all light 'Mechs (applied in combat).

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot believes survival is about never being where the enemy expects. Moves like a ghost, hits like a whisper. +21 affinity with all light 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员认为生存的关键是永远不出现在敌人预料的位置。行动如幽灵，打击如低语。对所有轻型机甲的偏好力+21（战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot treats the battlefield like a high-speed chess match—always three moves ahead and never in the same place twice. +42 affinity with all light 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员把战场当作一场高速棋局——永远领先三步，而且绝不在同一个地方待两次。与所有轻型机甲的契合度+42（在战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not too fast, not too slow. This pilot finds the perfect balance of firepower and mobility. Just right for delivering cockpit shots with surgical precision. +21 affinity with all medium 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不太快，也不太慢。这名飞行员在火力与机动性之间找到了完美平衡，恰好能以手术般的精准打出座舱命中。对所有中型机甲的偏好力+21（战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Precision is everything. This pilot moves fast enough to outmaneuver the enemy and fires just slow enough to make every shot count. +42 affinity with all medium 'Mechs (applied in combat).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 精准就是一切。这名飞行员移动得足够快以摆脱敌人，开火又足够慢，让每一枪都算数。与所有中型机甲的契合度+42（在战斗中生效）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot was the last claimant to the Star League throne.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员是星盟王位的最后一位宣称者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilot has a fighting spirit of legendary proportions
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员拥有传奇级别的战斗精神

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot was the first Discord bot to be written by the team.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员是团队写出的第一个Discord机器人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot has mastered indirect weapons and can better predict their trajectory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员精通间接武器，能更好地预测其弹道。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot opened a great market on Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员在地球开辟了一个大市场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot showed the power of the so-called \"Murderpede\".
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员展示了所谓"杀人蜈蚣"的威力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite being descended from Nicholas himself, this pilot largely rejects the ways of the Clans & zellbrigen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管是尼古拉斯的后裔，这名飞行员大体上拒绝氏族之道与泽尔布林根。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot destroyed the MAF, not even the nyanlings were spared.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员摧毁了MAF，连喵灵都没能幸免。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot returned to his Clan to embrace augmented combat and wreaks havoc on those who get in his way.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot's deep knowledge of tech and access to cutting edge research has given them deep insight into heat efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员对技术的深厚知识以及接触前沿研究的机会，让他们对热量效率有着深刻洞见。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot is a member of the secretive and elite 'Rangers', and has a way of pushing further and harder than most others.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员是神秘而精锐的"游骑兵"成员，拥有比多数人更努力、更深推一层的本领。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot stole and defaced others' recruitment propaganda, enabling them to recruit a vast number of minions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员偷走并涂改他人的招募宣传品，从而招募到大批爪牙。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot has a deep understanding of tech, but occasionally gets bit by it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员对技术有深刻理解，但偶尔也会被技术咬一口。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot may alter the balance. Pray they alter it no further.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员可能改变平衡。祈祷他们不要再进一步改变它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot has a cult following and is said to project a light about him. Unlike most saints however, his glow is that of heavy weapons ready to smite his foes.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员以猎取并囤积一切能弄到的战利品与技术而闻名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot runs their mouth, but is difficult to catch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员嘴上不饶人，但很难被抓住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot's storytelling ability causes enemies to become distracted.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot helps handle tickets, support, and so much more.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员执行了对阿特柔斯的轨道轰炸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
\"Regent and Protector of the Star League\", \"Defender of the First Lord\" & \"Great Father\" these are just some of the titles bestowed upon Alexandr Kerensky in life and in death.

Some say that even in death the spirit of Kerensky lives on, occasionally giving aid to mechwarriors it finds worthy, guiding them to great things.

"星盟摄政与守护者"、"第一领主之护卫"与"伟大之父"——这些只是亚历山德尔·克伦斯基生前身后被授予的部分头衔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This pilot helped found the doomed Third Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名飞行员参与创建了那注定覆灭的第三星盟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots dubbed \"assassins\" are masters of Offensive Push. They gain a significant bonus to Offensive Push accuracy, in addition to an increased chance to hit the called location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被称作"刺客"的飞行员是攻势推进的大师。除了击中指定部位的几率更高之外，他们在攻势推进的精度上还获得显著加成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Athletic pilots can take more of a beating than their peers, boasting a small increase to maximum HP and recovery speed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 体魄强健的机师比同僚更耐打，最大生命值和恢复速度都有小幅提升.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bookish pilots have increased sight and sensor range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 喜爱阅读的机师拥有更远的视野和传感器范围.
机师特质: 喜爱阅读

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brave pilots generate more Resolve and are less likely to panic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勇敢的机师会生成更多决心值，并且不容易陷入恐慌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots with command experience are able to inspire and coordinate their allies. While a commander is on the field, nearby allies gain a small bonus to Initiative and Tactics, generate additional Resolve per round, and are less likely to panic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拥有指挥经验的机师能够激励并协调友军. 当指挥官在场上时，附近的友军会获得先攻权与战术技能的小幅加成，每回合获得额外的决心值，并且更不容易陷入恐慌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Criminal pilots haven't quite left that life behind. Their illicit dealings sometimes bring in some additional spending money, but deals gone south can be a drain on the company funds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有犯罪背景的飞行员并没有完全抛下那种生活。他们的非法交易有时会带来一些额外的零花钱，但交易告吹也会成为公司资金的流失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dependable pilots are less likely to panic in the heat of battle. They also take reduced stability damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可靠的机师在激烈的战斗中更不容易陷入恐慌，同时受到的稳定性伤害也会降低.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Disgraced pilots reflect poorly on their company, but they are skilled at keeping a low profile - even in combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 身败名裂的机师会损害连队的声誉，但他们精于保持低调——即便身处战斗之中也是如此.
机师特质: 身败名裂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dishonest pilots are, unsurprisingly, not to be trusted. On top of the hot water they often find themselves in, the company coffers have a funny way of going up and down when they're around. Curious.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不诚实的飞行员不可信任，这一点毫不意外。除了他们常给自己招来的麻烦之外，只要他们在场，公司的账目总会以一种有趣的方式忽上忽下。真奇怪。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Drunkard pilots take additional stability damage, but have higher Offensive Push accuracy. Their blurred perception also makes it impossible for them to find the eject button in a panic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 醉鬼机师会承受额外的稳定性伤害，但“进攻推进”的命中率更高. 此外，由于感知模糊，他们在恐慌时根本找不到弹射按钮.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gladiator pilots deal more damage and stability damage with their melee attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 角斗士机师在使用近战攻击时，能造成更高的伤害与稳定性伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Honest pilots lift the spirits of the crew and provide a small increase to Morale.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 诚实的机师能提振全体成员的精神，并提供少量的士气加成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots with horrendous unlucky streaks. Allies and enemies deployed alongside a jinxed pilot have a chance for things to go wrong at the worst possible times.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 厄运缠身的机师运气背到极点. 与这类机师一同出战的友军和敌军，都有可能在最糟糕的时机碰上倒霉事.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots experienced with LosTech can lessen the strain on the 'Mech Bay. In addition, they reduce the operating costs of the Argo's Drive Systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 熟悉失落科技的飞行员能减轻机甲库的压力。此外，他们还能降低阿尔戈驱动系统的运营成本。
机师特质: 失落科技经验

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lucky pilots find their weapons jamming less frequently and their shots grouping more tightly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鸿运当头的机师会发现自己的武器卡壳频率更低，弹着点也更加密集.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Veteran MechWarriors have fast reactions and gain a small bonus to Initiative.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 资深机甲战士反应迅速，先攻值获得少量加成.
机师特质: 机甲战士

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots with mercantile experience continue to ply their side hustles on the Argo. They have a small chance to generate additional income, and know how to optimise bookkeeping to cut down on DropShip costs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拥有商业经验的机师会在阿尔戈号上继续经营自己的副业. 他们有较小的几率能创造额外收入，并且懂得如何优化账目以削减空投艇的相关开销.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots with formal military experience are tough as nails. They gain a small bonus to maximum HP and Offensive Push accuracy, and can manage high-recoil weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拥有正规军经历的机师坚毅如铁. 他们的最大生命值有小幅提升，“进攻推进”命中率也有加成，并且能够驾驭高后坐力武器.
机师特质: 退伍军人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots with neural implants are able to interface more directly with their 'Mech. Implants are required to gain the benefits of an active Enhanced Imaging or DNI-style cockpit, although the passive benefits of those cockpits will still apply to pilots without them. Cockpit Interface cockpits, however, require a pilot to possess neural implants to use at all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 带有神经植入体的飞行员能更直接地与机甲对接。要获得主动式增强成像或DNI式座舱的加成，需要植入体，不过那些座舱的被动加成对没有植入体的飞行员仍然适用。但座舱接口式座舱要求飞行员必须拥有神经植入体才能使用。
机师特质: 神经植入物

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Noble pilots are shrewd negotiators, and know how to use their connections to supplement the upkeep of the Argo's entertainment and medical facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 贵族飞行员是精明的谈判者，懂得利用人脉来补贴阿尔戈娱乐与医疗设施的维护费用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots with officer training increase the sight and sensor radius of their allies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 受过军官训练的机师能够增加友军的视野与传感器探测范围.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pilots with pain shunts ignore injuries from overheating, ammo explosions, and feedback caused by taking structure damage while using DNI cockpits. However, it does not protect against the small chance of injury from DNI failure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 配备痛觉屏蔽的机师会忽略因过热、弹药爆炸以及使用DNI驾驶舱时因结构受损产生的反馈所造成的伤害. 然而，它无法抵御DNI故障所造成的小概率伤害.
机师特质: 痛觉屏蔽

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reckless pilots have an easier time hitting fast-moving enemies with high evasion. Conversely, the maximum amount of evasion they themselves generate is reduced.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 鲁莽的机师更容易命中高速移动且具有高闪避值的敌人. 相反，他们自身能够产生的最大闪避值会降低.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Spacer pilots know a thing or two about spacecraft operations and can pitch in to keep costs down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太空人机师对航天器操作略知一二，能够帮忙搭把手以降低相关成本.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Technically-minded pilots can provide additional hands in the 'Mech Bay. Additionally, they reduce upkeep costs on the Argo's 'Mech Bay upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有技术头脑的飞行员能在机甲库中提供额外人手。此外，他们还能降低阿戈号机甲库升级的维护成本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You cannot deploy a pilot that is away for training.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 无法部署正在外接受训练的机师.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You may only deploy 2 pilots with reinforcement abilities
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你最多只能部署2名具备增援能力的飞行员
